children: SD Guthrie's renewable energy joint venture could provide steady recurring income, following its agreement to supply power to a U.S. technology company's data centers for 21 years, says Maybank IB analyst Ong Chee Ting in a note. The project will involve a solar plant with a minimum capacity of 680MW and a battery-storage system, with operations targeted for 2029. SD Guthrie could recognize 23 million-31 million ringgit in annual recurring income from 2029, equivalent to 3%-6% of its 500 million-700 million ringgit recurring income target from new businesses, he reckons. Maybank maintains a buy rating on SD Guthrie and keeps its target price at 7.10 ringgit. Shares are 0.5% lower at 6.13 ringgit.(yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
